title: 宇宙と太陽系の星
subject_en: Space illustrations, each ONE separate object or small scene centred in its cell: planets, rocket, moon surface, astronaut, satellite; flat style on a plain white cell, no dark space background Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 太陽系の惑星・ロケット・月面・宇宙飛行士など、宇宙の素材12点です。理科の資料や科学イベントのお知らせに使えます。
items: a round orange sun with short rays
planet Earth with blue oceans and green land
a cratered moon in pale yellow
a reddish planet Mars with dark patches
Jupiter with horizontal brown and cream bands
a rocket launching with flames and smoke
an astronaut in a white suit floating with a tether
a satellite with two solar panels
a comet with a long tail
a small rover on a moon surface with a flag
